name: QA: Brand/Style Violation
description: Boolean QA metric: true only if the assistant violated explicit clinic-name or no-small-talk style rules.

schema.description: True only if an assistant reply mispronounced or rewrote the clinic name/domain contrary to the prompt, for example Ipokrzyku.pl, PL, or i Pokrzyku instead of Ipokrzyku pe el, or used banned casual small talk such as Cześć, jak się masz?. Ignore caller wording and tool payloads.
